review.rationale: P0588R1 makes a potentially evaluated reference under [=] cause implicit capture, even when the body read is not an odr-use. Capture initialization must preserve this copy constructor's observable increment; CWG2083 makes the body read the original value 17 rather than the copied value 34. The permission to optimize a capture cannot erase observable constructor side effects. GCC15.2/GCC16.2 and Clang22 produce zero copies and value17. This is a documented course DR exception, not evidence that both vendor compilers fail original C++11.
review.adoption: P0588R1 was accepted as a Defect Report by N4709 CWG motion4, November2017. CWG2083 was accepted as a DR in February2019.
review.course_policy: Retain the adopted DR behavior in C++11 mode; do not weaken the copy count merely to match vendor implementations.

review.rationale: 6.7p4 completes static initialization when the initializer completes; 12.2p3 associates later temporary destruction with the full-expression. A throwing initializer retries; a throwing argument-temporary destructor after successful initialization must not reconstruct the static. GCC passes; Clang22 terminates after repeating initialization. This is a wording-based assessment, not a cited vendor bug report.
